Package edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data

Class RTBaroData

java.lang.Object
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTFudgedData
edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data.RTBaroData
public class RTBaroData extends RTFudgedData
Mutable barometer acquisition: pressure in hPa, temperature in Celsius and optional raw ADC counts. Raw values may be NaN at the simulator boundary.
